preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 6 and 200,000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The chosen vertices must be distinct.
The paths from (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) must have at least two common vertices.
The total length of the paths must be the sum of the lengths of the paths from (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).
